verdict.rationale: The axis applies: a buyer comparing auth products could fairly ask whether the vendor uses customer or user data for AI training. The evidence pack has no AI-training opt-out, no no-training policy, and no data-usage commitment of any kind. Community remarks that auth data lives in the developer's own database ("I own all the data") describe data ownership in a self-hosted library. That is an adjacent property, not a documented control or guarantee against training use, so it earns no credit here.
